title: Hearing on immigration enforcement activity in New York City
summary: The Council's Immigration Committee held an oversight hearing on November 20, 2026 examining the current state of federal immigration enforcement in New York City, alongside several related bills and a resolution. Topics included ICE detention and arrest practices, courthouse and shelter enforcement, cooperation between NYPD and federal immigration authorities, and recent high-profile incidents such as the October 8 shooting of Oscar Belgal in Marble Hill. Testimony was invited from the Mayor's Office of Immigrant Affairs, the NYPD, and immigrant and legal service providers.
